verification_candidates.claim_text: Intermittent fasting and water-only fasting do not cause loss of muscle mass.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: multiple studies have been done on intermittent fasting and on water-only fasting that prove you will not lose any muscle mass
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether fasting causes muscle loss is checkable and affects whether people try it.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Digestion, absorption, metabolism and storage of nutrients from meals can account for up to 50 percent of total daily energy expenditure.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it's estimated that digestion, absorption, metabolism, and the storage of nutrients from meals can account for as much as fifty percent of your total daily energy expenditure
verification_candidates.rationale: The 50% figure is checkable against physiology estimates.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Eating multiple meals a day leaves the body without enough energy to break food down, causing many diseases in the world population.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: This is the reason why the world population is suffering with so many diseases, because our body doesn't have enough energy to break down all of these meals that we're consuming
verification_candidates.rationale: The causal claim that meal frequency causes disease is checkable against nutrition and epidemiology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People eat five times as much as they need to eat to maintain proper health.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We're eating five times as much as we should need to eat to maintain proper health
verification_candidates.rationale: The fivefold overconsumption figure is checkable against calorie intake estimates.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When the digestive system stops during water fasting, the body creates autophagy and produces stem cells.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: This creates what is called autophagy
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether water fasting triggers autophagy and stem-cell production is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: During autophagy the body decomposes and burns diseased, damaged, aging or dead cells and tissues, including tumors, abscesses and toxic accumulations.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Autophagy is when your body starts to decompose. And burn cells and tissues, which are diseased or damaged
verification_candidates.rationale: Autophagy's targets are described in checkable biological terms, and the tumor claim is material.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Autophagy during water fasting usually starts around day three.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: autophagy, by the way, usually starts around day three
verification_candidates.rationale: The timing of autophagy onset is checkable and commonly repeated.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Three to five days into a water fast, growth hormone increases, which helps maintain muscle mass and lean tissue during the fast.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you're going to have increased levels of growth hormone, which will help you maintain the muscle
verification_candidates.rationale: The claim that fasting raises growth hormone and preserves muscle is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: During a water fast, almost all energy for basic metabolism is supplied by fatty acids and ketones.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: almost all of the energy you need for basic metabolism is now going to be supplied by fatty acids and ketones
verification_candidates.rationale: The metabolic fuel switch during fasting is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: During fasting the body targets and destroys abnormal cells, then produces new stem cells and regenerates the immune system.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it just starts attacking, and then starts repairing all of your cells. So then, your body starts producing new stem cells
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether fasting induces stem-cell production and immune regeneration is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: During autophagy the body breaks down unhealthy cells into component nutrients and rebuilds them as healthy cells to repair organs and tissues.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: the body disassembles all of the cells. And then uses those components and rebuilds them as healthy cells wherever you need them in the body
verification_candidates.rationale: The claimed recycling and rebuilding function of autophagy is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A 14-day water-only fast put a 40-year-old man's tissues in the same physiological condition as those of a 17-year-old.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: placed a 40-year-old man on a 14-day water-only fast. At the end of the fast, the man's tissues were in the Same physiological condition as those of a 17-year-old youth

verification_candidates.claim_text: Fasting old flatworms until near death and then refeeding them made them physiologically young, showing that fasting inhibits the aging process.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Professor Child concluded that partial starvation or fasting actually inhibits the aging process
verification_candidates.rationale: The flatworm experiments and the conclusion about aging can be checked.
